logp.method_description: n-Octanol/PBS partition coefficients were determined by vortex mixing (20 min) 3.0 mL of n-octanol, 3.0 mL of PBS, and 100 μL of the radiolabeled compound purified by SepPak. After centrifugation (3000g for 10 min), aliquots (100 μL) of both the organic and the aqueous phases were collected and counted with a γ-counter. Partition coefficients, expressed as (activity concentration in n-octanol)/(activity concentration in PBS), are reported in Table 1.
